notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New patch with new improvements. We also made some hotfixes this time.


HotFixes (Already in)
- Fixed a crash in level 8 if you completed the little friend achievement.
- Fixed eternal screenshake with near 0 configurations. 
- Fixed fade to black at the end of the level.
- Fixed dark zone in level 10.

Improvements
- New doors easy to spot when open.
- Level 1 made a little bit easier.
- Level 5 now doesn't have a box hiding important info. 
- Level 6 closes incorrect paths when a side is done.
- Level 6 has new checkpoints.

BugFix
- Boss 2 adds spawning badly.
- Doors & timed buttons bugging in certain cases.
- Some doors without collision.
- Sometimes enrage didn't end when character died.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 is here with a lot of improvements & bugfixes:

New Features
- Now in Level 5 your progress will be saved, keeping puzzles done and enemies dead.
- Now you can adjust the Screenshake in the options menu.
- Now the Level name is displayed at the begining.
- Completion time will now be displayed when finishing a level from level select.

Improvements
- Checkpoint moved in level 3 for the Little Friend achievement.
- New Little Friend message in Level 7.
- The third weapon bullet now moves slowly.
- More time to control the third weapon bullet separation.
- Now the weapon pickups are more visible and easy to spot.
- Now the barriers are more visible and easy to understand.
- Now there's a minimun time between jump and double jump.
- Now there's an input buffer to double jump if you trigger it too early.

BugFix
- Achievement "Too Angry" with permanent PowerUp - Enrage.
- Boss2 sometimes using his laser instantly.
- Weird crack on enrage sound.
- Infinite enrage if you ended a level with enrage.
- Text on Level 7 hiding gameplay area.
- Final Little Friend Text showing multiple times.
- Boss3 spike balls sound didn't stop after killilng the boss.
- Some puzzles bugs when triggering 2 buttons at the same time.
- Decals popping at screen border.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Little bugfixes and optimizatons:

CHANGES
- Level 3: Difficulty reduced in some parts and new hint added.
- Now the little friend's houses won't appear in the level if you come from level selection or if you're not doing the achievement.
- Now the little friend doesn't go out if it's in the last house of the level.
- Now the little friend's houses are blue if they are linked to a checkpoint.
- Now you can see how many aliens you have recollected in every level on the level select.
- Now if you pick up an alien, the next time it will be transparent.

BUGFIXES
- BugFix: Music not starting in 3rd boss.
- BugFix: Puzzle in level 9 not working as intended.
- BugFix: Enemies stuck in damage animation in some cases.
- BugFix: Some texts showing up where they shouldn't.
- BugFix: Losing character control when damaged at some points.
- BugFix: Some bullets in some places causing a crash.

notes.title: Release
notes.notes: Finally Automatum can be obtained via Steam!
